name: yapa
description: Persistent, team-shareable memory and tasks for Claude Code: per-prompt recall, teammate sync through the YAPA sync service (Google sign-in), journal and compaction capture.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your name in task IDs and on everything you sync. With the sync service it comes from your Google account and this is informational. Empty = your OS login name.

storage.title: Storage backend
storage.description: 'local' = embedded store, no server needed. 'chroma' = a ChromaDB server at the URL below.

sync_enabled.title: Team sync
sync_enabled.description: Share memories and tasks with your team through the YAPA sync service.

sync_service_url.title: Sync service URL
sync_service_url.description: Base URL of a YAPA sync service (any remote implementing YAPA Sync API v1), e.g. https://sync.example.com or https://example.com/api/yapa. Sign in once with `gcloud auth login`. See docs/connecting-to-a-remote.md before the first sync.

sync_mcp_url.title: Sync MCP URL
sync_mcp_url.description: URL of an MCP server (usually through an MCP gateway) that serves YAPA Sync API v1 as its yapa_sync tool. Wins over the service URL. Needs the MCP token command. See docs/connecting-to-a-remote.md before the first sync.

sync_mcp_token_cmd.title: Sync MCP token command
sync_mcp_token_cmd.description: Command that prints your bearer token for the MCP gateway in Sync MCP URL. YAPA reruns it when the token expires or is rejected.

sync_mcp_tool.title: Sync MCP tool name
sync_mcp_tool.description: The sync tool's exact name on the MCP server, when it is neither yapa_sync nor a single prefixed name such as remote__yapa_sync (for example when the gateway lists several).

sync_database_url.title: Sync database URL (advanced)
sync_database_url.description: Advanced/self-host: direct database URL (ignored when a service URL is set)

sync_ca_cert.title: Sync database CA certificate
sync_ca_cert.description: Advanced/self-host (direct database only): PEM file with the database server CA; the server certificate is verified against it.

remote_name.title: Remote name
remote_name.description: What your team's sync remote is called (e.g. acme). The status line then reads `yapa@v<version> <-> acme ● synced 2m ago`; empty shows just `yapa@v<version>`. Set it at install with `claude plugin install yapa@yapa --config remote_name=acme`.

statusline.title: Status line
statusline.description: Add YAPA's status line (version, remote, sync health, new releases) to your Claude Code settings at session start. An existing status line is kept and shown above it. Removing YAPA's status line yourself keeps it removed.

status_label.title: Status line name (deprecated)
status_label.description: Deprecated: use Remote name. Still read when Remote name is empty.

response_capture.title: Auto-capture findings
response_capture.description: After each turn, a small model (claude -p haiku, or your configured curation provider) stores durable findings, typed as findings, decisions, questions and so on, and records what the turn settles in open decisions and questions. Off: only what the agent stores itself.
